Mirtazapine has been investigated in the management of severe nausea and vomiting (p.1700). For mention of the successful use of mirtazapine to treat hyperemesis of pregnancy see Pregnancy, under Precautions, above. Further references. 1. Kast RE. Mirtazapine may be useful in treating nausea and in- somnia of cancer chemotherapy. Support Care Cancer 2001; 9: 469–70. 2. Caldis EV, Gair RD. Mirtazapine (Remeron) as treatment for non- mechanical vomiting after gastric bypass. Obes Surg 2005; 15: 707–9. Preparations USP 31: Mirtazapine Tablets.
